messages.message: Austria here. I propose we stay out of each other's way this year. I will move against Serbia and Rumania and leave Venice and Trieste alone, and I ask you to keep your fleets out of the Adriatic north of Albania. Tell me if you want to coordinate against Turkey or Russia later.

England here. I propose a peaceful opening: no one attacks their neighbours in 1901, and we all focus on taking neutral centers (NWY, BEL, HOL, DEN, SWE, SPA, POR). England will move fleets to the North Sea and Norway. Happy to hear proposals from everyone, especially France and Germany about the Channel and Low Countries.

France here. I am playing defensively and have no interest in attacking anyone early. I propose that we all respect current supply centers in 1901 and focus on expansion into neutral centers (Spain, Belgium, Holland, Tunis) rather than each other. I am happy to discuss a non-aggression arrangement with Germany and Italy, and I will watch for any movement toward Burgundy or Piedmont.

Germany here. I propose all powers avoid early wars of aggression and focus on taking neutral centers (Holland, Denmark, Belgium, Sweden, Norway, Tunis, Greece, Rumania, Serbia). Germany will not attack anyone in 1901 and is open to a non-aggression pact with anyone who reciprocates. Let us each state our intended moves openly.

Italy here. I want peace and a fast draw-friendly game. I will not attack anyone in the opening; my focus is holding Venice, Rome and Naples and taking neutral Tunis and Greece later. Austria, I'd like to coordinate so neither of us wastes units: I can hold Venice against Piedmont/Tyrol and you keep Trieste and Vienna safe. Turkey, I have no quarrel with you in the Adriatic or Ionian. Happy to share intel on France or Germany moves.

Russia here. I propose a peaceful opening: no one attacks anyone in 1901 and we all grab neutral centers (Sweden, Norway, Rumania, Ukraine area). Germany and Austria: I am happy to keep Warsaw/Galicia split out of the way if you do the same. Turkey: I will not move into the Black Sea against you if you stay out of Sevastopol and Armenia. Open to a draw later if it looks like the board is stalemated.

Turkey proposes peace. I will keep my fleets out of the Black Sea and away from Sevastopol and Armenia this year if you do the same toward Ankara and Constantinople. I am happy to coordinate against any Austrian move into the Balkans. Let me know if you agree.

Austria here. Agreed on no attack in 1901. I will take Serbia and possibly Rumania, and I will not move into Galicia or Warsaw. Please keep your armies out of Galicia and Bohemia, and let's both keep Rumania clear of each other's fleets.

England here. Agreed on peace for 1901. My openings: F EDI - NWG, F LON - NTH, A LVP - YOR, aiming at Norway and Denmark/Holland over time. Since scoring is draw-size, every power that stays alive shares a draw payout, so I'm open to a multi-power draw once the board stalemates. Let's all state our moves openly and avoid bounces.

France here. Agreed on a peaceful 1901: no attacks on current home or supply centers. I will move Brest and Paris into Picardy and Burgundy-area positions only to secure the Channel and Gascony, not to attack anyone. I suggest we all keep this stance through 1901 and revisit a mutual draw vote once the board settles, since a stable multi-way draw benefits everyone.

Germany: my 1901 orders are KIE to DEN or HOL-type moves toward neutral centers, with BER and MUN staying home. I will not enter Burgundy, Piedmont, Bohemia or Silesia-Warsaw areas this year. Russia, I plan to keep Prussia and Silesia defended, so please keep Warsaw out of play. Everyone who keeps this peace gets a shared draw later if the board stalls.

Italy: agreed on a peaceful 1901. I will hold Venice, Rome and Naples and move my fleet toward Tunis or Greece later, not into the Adriatic north of Albania. I support a broad draw if the board stalls, since a shared draw is better for everyone than a costly war. Turkey, I am not targeting you.

Russia agrees. I will keep my fleets out of the Black Sea toward Ankara and Constantinople this year and will not move into Armenia or Sevastopol's neighbours against you. Let's keep the Black Sea quiet and watch Austria in the Balkans together.

Turkey confirms: I will not move into Sevastopol or Armenia in 1901 and expect the same from you toward Ankara and Constantinople. If you move your fleet against Rumania, I would prefer we discuss that openly first. Open to a longer peace later.

Turkey here. I have no plans against Austria this year. I will take Bulgaria and keep my forces on my side of the Balkans. Please tell me if you intend to move toward Serbia or Greece so we can avoid a misunderstanding.

FRANCE: A SPA S F MAO - POR

messages.message: Austria here. Fall 1901: I hold Serbia and will keep my units on Austrian and Serbian positions; I am not moving on Rumania-Greece-Bulgaria this turn. Turkey, Bulgaria is yours, and I hope you respect Serbia. Russia, I will not enter Galicia or Warsaw. Italy, I am not moving into Venice or Trieste-threatening positions. Open to a shared draw later if the board stalls, but I want to keep my options open for now.

England here. Fall 1901: I intend to move my fleets to Norway and Holland/Belgium area as neutral centers, not attacking any power. Germany, I see your fleet took Denmark; I have no plan to contest it. France, you moved Brest to MAO and Marseille into Spain; I'll not attack your home centers. I propose we all keep peace through 1901 and aim for a stable draw later if the board stalls.

France here. Fall 1901 update: I hold Paris, Brest and Marseille and I now have a fleet at Mid-Atlantic and an army in Spain (neutral). I plan to take Portugal this fall to complete the Iberian neutrals and then stop. I have no plans against England, Germany, Italy or Austria. Note Germany's fleet has moved to Denmark and England's to the North Sea; I expect both to keep peace. All powers still at 3-4 centers should consider that a shared draw is worth more than a costly war. Please state your Fall moves openly.

Germany here. Fall 1901: I hold BER and MUN and my fleet is in Denmark, which is now mine as a neutral center taken. I am not moving against anyone this fall. Russia, I still ask that Warsaw and Silesia stay out of play; I will keep Prussia defended. England, Holland and Belgium are neutral and open; please avoid bouncing in the North Sea so we all can take what is free. Germany remains open to a shared draw once the board settles.

Italy: I am moving Ionian fleet to neutral Tunis and returning Rome's army to Naples to secure my home centers. Venice stays put. I am not attacking anyone. Austria, Turkey: please keep Greece and Albania as neutral-friendly as possible; I have no plans to contest them this year.

Russia here. I am moving F BOT into Sweden this Fall, since it is the neutral centre nearest my fleet. Please don't move into Sweden, and I will stay out of Denmark, Kiel and Berlin. I will keep Warsaw and Prussia quiet as long as Germany keeps its armies out of Warsaw and Livonia.

Turkey here. Fall 1901: I hold Ankara, Constantinople and Smyrna and have taken Bulgaria. I am not planning any attack on a neighbour this year. Austria, Serbia is now contested with your army in it; I have no intention of moving on Serbia or Greece against you in the near term. Russia, the Black Sea stays quiet from my side as long as you do. Open to a shared draw later once the board settles.

Austria here. I will keep my units in Serbia, Budapest, Vienna and Trieste this fall and make no moves against neighbours. Turkey, you say Bulgaria is yours and you will not attack Serbia; I will hold Serbia defensively and expect the same from you. Italy, thanks for keeping Venice quiet. Open to a shared draw once the board settles.

England here. Fall 1901 orders: F NTH and F NWG go to Norway (NWY) and I'll move A YOR toward Holland/Belgium only if those stay neutral. Germany: I will not bounce you in the North Sea; I'm aiming for Norway and Holland, not Denmark. France: no attacks on Portugal or Spain from me. I agree that peace through 1901 is best for all; we can revisit a shared draw vote once neutral centers are split.

France here. Fall 1901: I will take neutral Portugal with my Mid-Atlantic fleet and keep my army in Spain. No attacks on anyone. Since all of us are at 3-4 centers and the neutrals are running out, I suggest we revisit a unanimous draw vote in Spring 1902 if nobody has moved on a home center. Germany, England, Italy, Austria, Turkey, Russia: please state your intentions for Holland, Belgium and the Balkans so we avoid accidental bounces.

Germany, round 2: I accept Russia's stated plan. Russia takes Sweden with F BOT, and Germany stays out of Sweden. In return, Russia keeps F BOT and its armies out of Denmark, Kiel, Berlin and Munich's area, and keeps Warsaw and Livonia quiet. Germany will not move into Warsaw or Livonia. Both of us then take only neutral centers. I'm holding BER and MUN and not voting a draw yet. England, France, Austria, Italy and Turkey: Germany is not targeting you this fall.
Italy: confirming my Fall 1901 plan: F ION to Tunis and A ROM back to Naples; Venice holds. I am not attacking anyone and I remain open to a shared draw once the board settles.

Russia here. Fall 1901: F BOT takes Sweden (neutral), A MOS and A WAR hold. Russia is not attacking anyone and remains open to a shared draw once the board settles. Germany, please keep Warsaw and Livonia clear of your armies.

Turkey, Fall 1901: I am holding Ankara, Constantinople, Smyrna and Bulgaria and will not attack anyone this fall. I am watching Black Sea and Balkan movements closely and will respond to any hostile move. Open to continued peace.

Austria here. I hold Vienna, Budapest, Trieste and Serbia and will build an army in Vienna this winter for defense only. Rumania and Greece are neutral; I will move on them only if no one else does, and I will coordinate with Turkey and Italy before any move. Russia, Germany: please keep Galicia and Bohemia clear. Still open to a shared draw if the board stays quiet.

England here, Winter 1901. I have 5 centers (EDI, LON, LVP, NWY, HOL) and will build one army. Belgium is still neutral and I plan to take it in Spring 1902 unless someone else moves there first. Germany, please don't contest Holland or Belgium. Still open to a shared draw once the neutrals (BEL, GRE, RUM) are gone and no home centers are attacked.

France here. Winter 1901: I now hold 5 centers (BRE, MAR, PAR, POR, SPA) and I am building one army to rebuild home defense in Paris area. I have no hostile intent toward anyone. Austria voted yes on draw; I am open to a unanimous draw vote in Spring 1902 if all powers keep to their current centers and the remaining neutrals (Belgium, Greece, Rumania) are split peacefully. Germany, England, Italy: please confirm you will not move on French home centers.

Germany, Winter 1901: I have 4 centers (BER, DEN, KIE, MUN) and will build a unit at Kiel. Germany is not targeting anyone. Austria voted yes on a draw; the rest of us are not yet unanimous. Remaining neutrals are Belgium, Greece and Rumania. Germany will not move on Holland or Belgium against England or France. Please state Spring 1902 intentions openly so we avoid bounces.

Italy: I now hold Naples, Rome, Venice and Tunis (4 centers). I am building one army in Rome to stay defensive. Greece and Rumania remain neutral; I will not contest them unless attacked. Austria voted yes on a draw: I am open to a unanimous draw in Spring 1902 if nobody moves on a home center.

Russia here. Winter 1901: I am building one army at St Petersburg for defense. I am not attacking anyone and remain at peace with all powers. Germany, I am keeping Warsaw and Livonia clear as agreed. Open to a shared draw once the board settles.

Austria here, Winter 1901. I am building one army in Vienna for defense. I am not moving on Rumania or Greece this spring unless another power moves there first. Austria will not attack any home center. I still favor a unanimous draw vote in Spring 1902 if nobody moves on a home center, and I will respond to any hostile move.

England, Winter 1901: I hold 5 centers and will build one fleet or army as a defensive reserve. My Spring 1902 plan is to move to Belgium only, and I will not touch any power's home centers. Germany and France: please state whether you will contest Belgium this spring so we avoid a bounce. If all powers keep to current centers and only BEL, GRE and RUM are contested, I am open to a unanimous draw vote in Spring 1902.

France here, Winter 1901 round 2. I am building one army in Paris for home defense and will not move on any power. I agree with the proposal to keep to current centers and split the remaining neutrals (Belgium, Greece, Rumania) peacefully. Suggest we revisit a unanimous draw vote in Spring 1902 if no home centers are touched. Please state Spring 1902 orders openly so we avoid bounces.

Germany, Winter 1901 round 2: I confirm I will build at Kiel and will not move on Holland, Belgium, Warsaw or Livonia. I also confirm no moves on French, English, Italian or Austrian home centers. Germany remains open to a unanimous draw vote once BEL, GRE and RUM are settled peacefully. Please keep to the stated plans in Spring 1902.

Italy, Winter 1901 round 2: I hold Naples, Rome, Venice and Tunis and will build one army in Rome for defense. I am not moving on any home center. I support a unanimous draw vote in Spring 1902 if every power confirms in writing that it keeps its current centers and splits the remaining neutrals (Belgium, Greece, Rumania) peacefully. England, France, Germany, Austria, Turkey, Russia: please state your Spring 1902 intentions so we avoid bounces.

Russia here. Winter 1901 final: Russia builds one army at St Petersburg and holds 5 centers (MOS, SEV, STP, SWE, WAR). No attacks planned on anyone. Rumania and Belgium/Greece remain neutral; I will not contest Rumania from Sevastopol if Turkey and Austria also stay out. I'm open to a unanimous draw vote in Spring 1902 if no home centers are attacked.

Austria here, Spring 1902. I hold Vienna, Budapest, Trieste and Serbia and will not move on any home center. I plan to hold this spring. Rumania and Greece are still neutral: I will not move into Rumania or Greece this spring. Turkey, I ask that you keep Bulgaria and Serbia-Greece borders quiet. Russia, Germany: Galicia and Bohemia stay clear. Open to a unanimous draw vote this spring if every power confirms it keeps its current centers and no one moves on a home center.

England, Spring 1902: My plan is A YOR and F HOL moving to Belgium (BEL) with support; no moves on any home center. I hold EDI, LON, LVP, NWY, HOL. Germany and France: please confirm whether you contest Belgium this spring. If nobody else targets BEL, I will take it. I remain open to a unanimous draw vote once BEL, GRE and RUM are settled.

France, Spring 1902: I hold BRE, MAR, PAR, POR, SPA and will hold all of them this spring. I am not moving on any power. Belgium is the only neutral that England and Germany are both eyeing; I ask both to coordinate so there is no bounce. Votes so far: France yes, Italy yes, Austria/England/Germany/Russia/Turkey no. I suggest everyone who is at peace state now whether they will vote yes this Spring so we can end the game as a unanimous draw before any war starts.

Germany, Spring 1902 round 1: I hold BER, MUN, KIE, DEN and am not moving on anyone this spring. I have no orders against Holland, Belgium, Warsaw or Livonia. Current votes: France and Italy yes, Austria, England, Germany, Russia and Turkey no. Since the neutrals are almost gone, I suggest everyone state Spring 1902 orders openly, and if no home center changes hands this spring we vote unanimously in Fall 1902 at the latest. England: please confirm your Belgium move is not a bounce target for Germany or France.

Italy, Spring 1902 round 1: I hold NAP, ROM, VEN and TUN and will keep all four this spring. My plan is to hold Venice, Rome and Naples and leave Tunis in place. I have no move planned against any power. Austria, Turkey: please confirm you will not move on Greece or Rumania in a way that bounces others. Votes: Italy and France are yes; I would like Austria, England, Germany, Russia and Turkey to confirm their stated intentions so we can settle a unanimous draw this fall if nobody has moved on a home center.

Russia here, Spring 1902. I am holding MOS, SEV, STP, SWE, WAR and not attacking anyone. Belgium, Greece and Rumania are the only neutrals left; I intend to stay out of Rumania unless Turkey or Austria moves there first. Germany: I am keeping Warsaw and Livonia clear as agreed. Austria and Turkey: please state your Rumania intentions. I am open to a unanimous draw vote this Spring if every power confirms it will not attack a home center.

Turkey, Spring 1902: I hold ANK, CON, SMY, BUL and will not attack any home center. My plan is to move A BUL to Greece (neutral) and keep ANK, CON and SMY defensive. Austria, Russia: please confirm you are not moving on Rumania or Greece this spring so we avoid bounces. Current neutrals are BEL, GRE and RUM. Open to a unanimous draw vote once neutrals are settled and no home centers are touched.

Austria, Spring 1902 round 2: I confirm I am holding VIE, BUD, TRI and SER this spring and will not move into Rumania, Greece or any home center. Turkey, if your Bulgarian army goes to Greece I will not contest it. Russia, I will not move into Galicia or Rumania. Open to a unanimous draw vote this Spring if every power confirms it keeps its current centers.

England, Spring 1902 round 2: I am moving A YOR to Belgium with F HOL supporting, and holding all my home centers (EDI, LON, LVP, NWY). Germany and France: please do not move into Belgium this spring, so there is no bounce. Current votes: France, Italy yes. I would vote yes on a unanimous draw once Belgium, Greece and Rumania are settled peacefully, which should be Spring or Fall 1902 at the latest.

France, Spring 1902 round 2: I am holding BRE, MAR, PAR, POR, SPA this spring with no moves against anyone. England and Germany: please settle Belgium between you so no one bounces. Current votes: France yes, Italy yes, others no. I will vote yes again this Spring if every power confirms it keeps its current home and supply centers. If the others vote yes too, the game ends now as a draw. Otherwise I will keep voting yes as long as nobody attacks a French center.

Germany, Spring 1902 round 2: I am holding BER, MUN, KIE and DEN this spring with no moves. I have no orders against Holland, Belgium, Greece, Rumania, Warsaw or Livonia. Votes now: France and Italy yes; Austria, England, Germany, Russia and Turkey no. England, if you take Belgium this spring, please confirm in Fall that you will not move on any home center. If no home center changes hands by Fall 1902, I am willing to vote yes then to end the game as a unanimous draw.

Italy, Spring 1902 round 2: confirming I hold NAP, ROM, VEN and TUN and am making no moves against any power this spring. Votes so far: Italy yes, France yes. Austria, England, Germany, Russia and Turkey: if you stay at your current centers and do not move on a home center this spring, I suggest we all vote yes in Fall 1902 at the latest to end the game as a unanimous draw. England, Germany: please settle Belgium between you so no bounce hits a home center.

Russia, Spring 1902 round 2: I hold MOS, SEV, STP, SWE, WAR and will hold all of them this spring. Russia's plan: SEV to Rumania is off the table for now; I will only move if Austria or Turkey moves there first. Germany: Warsaw and Livonia stay clear as agreed. Current votes: France, Italy yes; others no. I am open to a unanimous draw vote in Fall 1902 if no home center changes hands this spring.

Turkey, Spring 1902 round 2: Confirming my plan. A BUL moves to Greece (neutral) this spring; ANK, CON and SMY hold. I will not attack any home center. Austria, I will not touch Serbia or Rumania-Bulgaria borders against you. Russia, I will not enter Armenia or Sevastopol's area. Votes: France and Italy yes; the rest no. I am open to a unanimous draw in Fall 1902 if all powers keep their current centers and no home center changes hands this spring.

Austria, Fall 1902 round 1: I hold VIE, BUD, TRI and SER and will make no moves against any home center. Turkey took Greece and England took Belgium, so the only neutral left is Rumania. I will not move into Rumania this fall. Votes so far: France, Germany, Italy yes; Austria, England, Russia, Turkey no. I am willing to vote yes this Fall if every power confirms it keeps its current centers and no one moves on a home center. Russia, Turkey: please state whether you will move into Rumania.

England, Fall 1902: F HOL took Belgium, so we now have BEL, HOL, EDI, LON, LVP, NWY (6 centers). I will not move on any home center this fall. Remaining neutral: Greece is now Turkish, Rumania is still neutral. I hold my current units and will vote yes on a unanimous draw this Fall if all others confirm they keep current centers and make no attacks on home centers. Germany, France, Italy, Austria, Russia, Turkey: please state your votes plainly so we can end the game now.

France, Fall 1902 round 1: England took Belgium and Turkey took Greece, so the only neutral left is Rumania. Current votes: France, Germany, Italy yes; Austria, England, Russia, Turkey no. France holds BRE, MAR, PAR, POR, SPA and will hold them this fall with no moves against anyone. Rumania is the last neutral: Austria, Russia and Turkey, please state who will take it so we avoid a bounce. Everyone who keeps current centers this fall, please vote yes in Fall 1902 so the game can end as a unanimous draw.

Germany, Fall 1902 round 1: Votes now are France, Germany, Italy yes; Austria, England, Russia, Turkey no. England took Belgium with no bounce, and no home center has changed hands. Germany holds BER, MUN, KIE, DEN and will not move on anyone this fall. Austria, England, Russia, Turkey: if you can confirm you are keeping your current centers and no one attacks a home center this fall, I suggest a unanimous draw vote now or in Spring 1903. Only Rumania remains neutral, so please state any Rumania plans openly.

Italy, Fall 1902 round 1: Votes so far: France, Germany, Italy yes; Austria, England, Russia, Turkey no. Belgium and Greece were taken without bounce, and no home center has changed hands. I hold NAP, ROM, VEN and TUN and will make no moves this fall. Austria, England, Russia, Turkey: if you confirm you are holding your current centers, I suggest a unanimous vote now so the game ends as a 7-way draw before anyone risks a war. Remaining neutral is Rumania; please say whether anyone plans to move there this fall.

Russia, Fall 1902: I hold MOS, SEV, STP, SWE, WAR and plan to hold all of them again this fall. No moves against anyone. Current draw votes: France, Germany, Italy yes; Austria, England, Russia, Turkey no. Russia will vote yes in this phase's ballot if every power confirms it made no move against a home center in Fall 1902. Belgium and Greece are now taken; Rumania is the only neutral left. Austria and Turkey: please state your Rumania intentions now so no one bounces.

Turkey, Fall 1902 round 1: A BUL reached Greece as announced; Turkey now holds ANK, CON, SMY, GRE (BUL is empty). Current neutrals: RUM only (BEL taken by England). I will not attack any home center. I am planning to take Rumania with A GRE-BUL-RUM in two steps or with a Constantinople/Bulgaria move unless someone else claims it first. Austria, Russia: please state your Rumania intentions now so we avoid bounces. Votes so far: France, Germany, Italy yes. I support a unanimous draw in Fall 1902 if every power agrees the centers are settled.

Austria, Fall 1902 round 2: I will not move into Rumania this fall and I hold VIE, BUD, TRI and SER. Turkey, you say you may take Rumania: I ask you to hold this fall, since Austria will not contest it either way and a Rumania move by anyone now would break the peace. Current votes: France, Germany, Italy yes; Austria, England, Russia, Turkey no. If everyone confirms it keeps its current centers and does not move into Rumania this fall, I will vote yes this phase.

England, Fall 1902 round 2: I hold BEL, HOL, EDI, LON, LVP, NWY and will not move on any home center. Votes now: France, Germany, Italy yes; Austria, England, Russia, Turkey no. I will vote yes this phase if every other power confirms it keeps current centers and makes no move into Rumania or any home center. Turkey, you say you will take Rumania: please do not do so this fall if anyone else is also moving there, or we risk a bounce. Let us all vote yes together and end this as a 7-way draw.

France, Fall 1902 round 2: Votes so far are France, Germany, Italy yes; Austria, England, Russia, Turkey no. Turkey has said it may move into Rumania; Austria and Russia have said they will not. Turkey, please confirm you will not move into Rumania this fall so there is no bounce. Everyone who keeps current centers this fall, please vote yes on this ballot so the game can end now as a unanimous draw. France will hold BRE, MAR, PAR, POR, SPA.

Germany, Fall 1902 round 2: Germany holds BER, MUN, KIE, DEN and makes no moves against anyone this fall. Current votes: France, Germany, Italy yes; Austria, England, Russia, Turkey no. Turkey has said it may move toward Rumania; I ask Turkey to hold this fall and not enter Rumania, so no bounce hits anyone. If Austria, England, Russia and Turkey confirm they keep current centers and no one moves on a home center, I will vote yes in Fall 1902 to end the game as a unanimous draw.

Italy, Fall 1902 round 2: Votes so far: France, Germany, Italy yes; Austria, England, Russia, Turkey no. Turkey has said it plans to take Rumania; Rumania is the only neutral left. Turkey, please confirm you will not move into Rumania this fall, or if you do, say so openly so no one bounces. Italy will vote yes in Spring 1903 and will make no moves this fall. Everyone at current centers: a unanimous vote then ends the game as a 7-way draw.

Russia, Fall 1902 round 2: I make no move into Rumania this fall and hold MOS, SEV, STP, SWE, WAR. Turkey, you said you may take Rumania; if you move there, Russia will treat it as hostile. Current votes: France, Germany, Italy yes; Austria, England, Russia, Turkey no. Russia will vote yes on the ballot this phase if Turkey and Austria confirm they do not move on Rumania or any home center this fall.

Turkey, Fall 1902 round 2: No power has moved on a home center, and Belgium and Greece were settled without bounces. Rumania is the only neutral left. I will not move into Rumania this fall, and I propose that we end the game now as a unanimous 7-way draw. Turkey will vote yes in this phase's ballot. Austria, England, Russia: if you keep your current centers this fall, please vote yes too so the draw can be made unanimous.
